description: Defines NGAP metrics structures, cause-to-index conversions, counters, and formatting functions for NGAP-related statistics in a 3GPP network context.

classes.name: ngap_counter_with_cause
classes.description: A counter for each NGAP cause value, supporting increment, retrieval, and iteration.

classes.name: pdu_session_metrics_t
classes.description: Metrics related to PDU session setup attempts and failures.

classes.name: ngap_metrics
classes.description: Aggregated NGAP metrics for all UEs connected to an AMF.

classes.name: ngap_info
classes.description: Metrics per NGAP node (AMF), including name, connection status, supported PLMNs, and metrics.

methods.name: cause_to_index
methods.description: Converts a cause value to an index for counters.

methods.name: index_to_cause
methods.description: Converts an index back to a cause value.

methods.name: ngap_counter_with_cause::increase
methods.description: Increments the counter for a specific cause.

methods.name: ngap_counter_with_cause::get_count
methods.description: Retrieves the count for a specific cause or index.

methods.name: format_ngap_metrics
methods.description: Formats NGAP metrics report into a string.
